pages.text: $(italic)The builder and engineer. An average fighter with no combat tradeoffs, whose power comes from crafting and infrastructure.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: 0% (no penalty)  |  Equipment HP: Full$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$() No penalties; crafted items benefit from bonuses

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Crafting Mastery$(): +15% mining speed and a baseline +10% attack speed. Nearby crafting tables give you Speed I.$(br2)$(bold)Engineer Speed$(): +10% bonus ore drops from mining, infrastructure power that compounds over time.$(br2)$(bold)Resourceful$(): as an $(thing)Artificer$() you draw your power from building, and time spent on infrastructure pays off.

pages.title: The Builder's Path
pages.text: The $(thing)Artificer$() is the only class with no combat tradeoffs. It is an average fighter and excels at everything else. If you would rather spend your time on building, crafting and automation than on combat, this is your class.

pages.title: Race Pairings
pages.text: $(thing)Dwarf$(): +25% mining speed that stacks with Crafting Mastery, and fire resistance for Nether resource runs.$(br2)$(thing)Halfling$(): food efficiency plus the ore bonus, for maximum resource gathering.$(br2)$(thing)Human$(): +15% XP and the Versatile bonus, for jack-of-all-trades building.
